entities.name: Sidelink discovery monitoring procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by a UE capable of sidelink discovery when configured to monitor NR sidelink discovery messages. The UE configures lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and corresponding data using appropriate resource pools.

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration message
entities.description: RRC message used to reconfigure UE parameters, including sidelink discovery configuration.

entities.name: System Information Block 12
entities.description: System information block containing sidelink communication and discovery configuration parameters.

entities.name: sl-FreqInfoToAddModList
entities.description: Information element in RRCReconfiguration containing list of frequencies for sidelink operation.

entities.name: sl-DiscConfig
entities.description: Information element in RRCReconfiguration containing sidelink discovery configuration.

entities.name: sl-FreqInfoList
entities.description: Information element in SIB12 containing list of frequencies for sidelink operation.

entities.name: sl-DiscConfigCommon
entities.description: Information element in SIB12 containing common sidelink discovery configuration.

entities.name: sl-DiscRxPool
entities.description: Information element containing resource pool configuration for sidelink discovery reception.

entities.name: sl-RxPool
entities.description: Information element containing resource pool configuration for sidelink reception.

entities.name: SL-PreconfigurationNR
entities.description: Preconfigured sidelink parameters used when UE is out of coverage.

entities.name: Reconfiguration with sync condition
entities.description: Condition where RRCReconfiguration includes reconfigurationWithSync, indicating handover scenario.

entities.name: Out of coverage condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is out of coverage on the concerned frequency for NR sidelink discovery.

entities.name: Monitor sidelink control information and data
entities.description: Behavior where UE configures lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and corresponding data using specified resource pools.

relations.description: Procedure requires RRCReconfiguration message for configuration
Procedure requires SIB12 for configuration when cell provides it
Reconfiguration with sync condition guards the use of sl-DiscRxPool
Reconfiguration with sync condition guards the use of sl-RxPool
Out of coverage condition guards the use of SL-PreconfigurationNR
Procedure establishes the property of monitoring sidelink control information and data
